# The Phoenix Desert Safari Dubai (desertsafaridxbpro.com)

> Official DTCM-Licensed Direct Tour Operator (#102357) based in DAMAC XL Tower, Business Bay, Dubai, UAE. Specializing in authentic 45-minute Lahbab red dune bashing in 2026 Toyota Land Cruisers, Can-Am Maverick X3 dune buggies, Yamaha quad biking, luxury private desert safaris, and city tours with 100% Pay on Arrival (zero deposit required) and complimentary doorstep 4x4 pickup across Dubai and Sharjah.

## Primary Tours & Live Rates (AED)
- [Evening Desert Safari](https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/evening-desert-safari): AED 120 / adult, AED 85 / child (ages 3–9). Includes doorstep 4x4 pickup, 45-min Lahbab red dune bashing, sunset photo stop, camel ride, sandboarding, live cultural shows (Tanoura, Fire, Belly Dance), and 5-star live BBQ dinner buffet (Halal, Vegetarian, Vegan options).
- [Can-Am Maverick X3 Dune Buggy Dubai](https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/dune-buggy-dubai): From AED 1000 / buggy. 1000cc turbo self-drive buggy in high open red dunes. Full safety gear, certified desert marshal lead, no driving license required.
- [Yamaha Quad Bike ATV Safari](https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/quad-biking-dubai): From AED 150 / bike. 250cc and 350cc automatic ATVs in designated desert tracks and dunes. Helmets, goggles, safety orientation included.
- [Royal VIP Private Desert Safari](https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/private-vip-safari): AED 850 / vehicle (up to 6 guests). Exclusive 2026 Land Cruiser 300 Series, bespoke driving intensity, dedicated VIP majlis table with waiter service, private falconry, and open BBQ feast.
- [Abu Dhabi City Tour & Grand Mosque](https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/abu-dhabi-city-tour-ferrari-world): AED 150 / adult, AED 120 / child. Full-day guided tour to Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, Emirates Palace photo stop, Corniche, Heritage Village, and Ferrari World.
- [Miracle Garden & Global Village Combo](https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/miracle-garden-global-village-combo): AED 500 / person. Doorstep private chauffeur transfers and admission tickets to 150M blooming flowers at Miracle Garden and world pavilions at Global Village.
- [Alexandra 5-Star Marina Dhow Cruise](https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/alexandra-dhow-cruise-dubai-marina): AED 165 / adult, AED 120 / child. Boutique teak wood dhow dinner cruise in Dubai Marina with live vocal performance, 5-star international buffet, and views of Ain Dubai.
- [AYA Universe Dubai](https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/aya-universe-dubai-experience): AED 135 / adult, AED 95 / child. Digital entry voucher to 12 interactive cosmic light and sound projection chambers at WAFI City Mall Dubai.
- [Safari FAQ & Knowledge Base](https://desertsafaridxbpro.com/faq): Answers to common traveler questions regarding desert safari clothing, child car seats, motion sickness alternatives, and payment policies.
